entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 738259665062428416: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 53229: distance 29.087 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.006), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 29.087 +/- 0.175 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 32.9210 +/- 0.1775 mas (same row, RUWE 2.17), 185.5 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 90.625, -278.664 mas/yr. Radial velocity from SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 738259665062428416 (quality A), from 2005A&A...430..165F; Gaia DR3 measures none.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 7.909 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 53229: radius 7.909 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 28.492 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.053) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4745 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 53229: effective temperature 4745 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.063).

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,745 K and log g 2.73 (u1 0.704, u2 0.092): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used. Gravity: log g 2.73 from 2013ApJ...764...78R; the 12 published values span log g 2.5 to 3, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.1% of the centre brightness.
